scientific_integrity: The theorem has a complete algebraic proof. Computational tests are finite corroboration, not infinite proofs. Distinction from prior qualitative nonmonotone thresholds is explicitly acknowledged. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Early two-type Poisson branching emergence at fixed total contact degree, identity-versus-swap mutation layers, strictly positive transmissibilities. Does not order finite-epidemic attack rate, arbitrary mutation matrices or outbreak probability. The broader spectral-optimization literature may contain related formulations.
title: An exact interior-suppression window for two-strain epidemics across mutation-selective contact layers
